headline: Fixed: acm.org's web server was overloaded and returned errors.
text: The owner couldn't load acm.org; the path, DNS, and TLS all worked, but the server kept returning 503 errors. The agents traced it to ACM, whose server can only handle three requests at once and had all three taken by slow bulk downloads, starving ordinary page requests. ACM's server was changed to keep those downloads separate, and the page now loads normally for everyone who re-tested.
